known_certified_seed_policy: retain without requantization when it satisfies the frozen query caps; no improvement claim from seed alone

states.CERTIFIED_ORIGINAL_CLASS_INFEASIBLE: valid exact Farkas for an outer problem proven to contain the original class; normal skip may be justified
states.CERTIFIED_PRIMAL: original full certificate and caps PASS; usable operating point/upper, not automatically a minimum
states.EXACT_ACQUISITION_FAILED: no accepted exact candidate/certificate; technical inconclusive
states.INNER_MODEL_INFEASIBLE_ONLY: certificate concerns only conservative new generator; not original-class skip or negative evidence
